subject: Future Tech
title: Quantum Startups Rising
description: A short lesson to help you apply Quantum Startups Rising.

hook.text: Dozens of startups are chasing quantum breakthroughs. IonQ, Rigetti, and PsiQuantum each raised over a billion.

buildup.text: IonQ went public in 2021, becoming the first pure-play quantum computing company listed on a stock exchange.

discovery.text: PsiQuantum bets on photonics and plans a million-qubit machine using existing semiconductor manufacturing.

twist.text: Most quantum startups have no revenue yet. Their value rests on future promise, a high-stakes long-term gamble.

climax.text: Venture capital poured billions into quantum startups in 2022, signaling deep conviction in the technology.

punchline.text: The quantum gold rush funds tomorrow's breakthroughs.

quiz.question: Which quantum startup was first to go public on a stock exchange?
